spiritgiven.comments: Fun and intense game! If they could speed up putting a line on offense it would be great!
Amazing game! Good spirit throughout the whole games and calls were resolved quickly!
Great game and super intense! We noticed negative attitude towards us on the sideline and on the field every time we would call fouls or picks… everything else was fine.
Good game! Nice adjustment on the side line and calls were resolved quickly!
Good game, communication was great, very nice team!
Very fun tight game but a lot of contact on the mark and on the cutters.
Good spirited game against our north american rivals!
Intense game, some calls felt like they benefit Italy and communication could have been quicker. Great game overall!

spiritreceived.comments: Good game and fun hustle! Perhaps watch a little on the contact and it would be nice if the team could give their perspective during their discussion of calls. Thanks for the game:-)
We really enjoyed playing such a high quality team, with really good pulls, deep shots and a range of athleticism. Good luck in the rest of the tournament!

Great game, good intensity all the way through. We felt many of the Canadian calls and discussions were about benefiting Canada which is why we marked lower for rules knowledge and use and fair-mindedness. They were receptive to our spirit discussions after we talked to them which is why we marked up on communication.
Such a good game! A little physical on both sides, but not enough for a 1. Great game either way, hope to see them again!

We believe there were several calls made during this game on an unreasonable basis (travels, fouls, etc) which reflects poor fair mindedness. Some were contested and some were overruled by video. 
During this game there was also a disconnect between the coaches' decisions and the information distributes to the players in relation to covid protocols. This led to some frustration and conflict between players on the sidelines before it was resolved. This is not part of the scores, just a note.
Loved the energy and that you gave everything having an amazing come back! Thank you for the tough game!
This game had good communication, especially during foul calls. Spirit improved thoughout the game and was better than last game.
